text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is German.
Russian(x) ::: x is Russian.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
MemberOfParliament(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
MemberOfReichstag(x) ::: x is a member of the Nazi Reichstag.

Premises:
HeinrichSchmidt ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician. (Assuming a constant for Heinrich Schmidt)
HeinrichSchmidt is a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
HeinrichSchmidt is a member of the Nazi Reichstag.

Conclusion:
German(HeinrichSchmidt) ∨ Russian(HeinrichSchmidt) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was German or Russian or both.
